g.title: task2view
g.text: Task2View pipeline (ADR-006, ADR-007, ADR-008): request + repository -> checked architectural views

g.title: cluster_understand
g.text: A. Understand the request (what must be shown?)

g.title: cluster_evidence
g.text: B. Find the evidence (what does the code actually contain?)

g.title: cluster_views
g.text: C. Build, draw and check the views

g.title: p1
g.text: every item quoted from the request
view spec: scope, granularity, behaviour; <= 3 clarifications

g.title: p0
g.text: entry points, entities, deployment, layers, signals

g.title: p3
g.text: smallest set of V&B viewpoints covering the primary needs (max 3),
only viewpoints drawn as a UML diagram type
+ C&C style and layer overlay from repository signals

g.title: p2
g.text: one question per view and subject

g.title: p4
g.text: one task per view, starting points from the card

g.title: pa
g.text: classes grouped into parts by architectural role;
arrows lifted from code dependencies, against-layering flagged;
one set of parts per request; names checked by code

g.title: p5
g.text: read code, return claims citing file, lines, code

g.title: v5
g.text: file, lines, quoted code, symbol exist?

g.title: aem
g.text: components (named after classes), relations from the graph,

g.title: p6
g.text: confirm / simplify / request evidence / gap / drop

g.title: p7
g.text: use case, activity, state machine; Annex A frame

g.title: p8
g.text: true to the code? readable? matches the spec?

g.title: out
g.text: traceability, validation report, usage and cost
